candidate.raw_translation: Lokacin da kake gudanar da binciken, mai warware DNS na Cloudflare na jama'a yana karɓar sunayen shafukan da aka tambaya da adireshin IP na mai bincike. Kayan aikin ba ya aika imel, bincika abun cikin saƙo, tabbatar da mai aikawa ko adana sakamakon. Rikodin DNS na iya canzawa kuma amsoshin masu warwarewa na iya ajiye su a cikin ajiya. Asusun bincike na SPF yana da ɓangare: wannan shafi ba ya yin nazarin macros na mai aikawa ko ya faɗaɗa gaba ɗaya a, mx, ptr da mechanisms. DKIM masu zaɓa dole ne a samar da su; wannan shafi ba ya gano su.
candidate.source: When you run the check, Cloudflare’s public DNS resolver receives the queried domain names and your browser IP address. The tool does not send email, inspect message content, verify an actual sender or save the results. DNS records can change and resolver responses may be cached. SPF lookup accounting is partial: this page does not evaluate sender-specific macros or fully expand a, mx, ptr and exists mechanisms. DKIM selectors must be supplied; this page does not discover them.
